content: Nzalisogho
Bandughu ba me mu kana, ka likala balagha ba baaluo mandagha ma Nzaami o. Mu kuulu be lisoolo ti bihi baluo, Nzaami sa alamana bihi mu mpini.
Bihi bwohono liikabwa mu masumu mansa malagha. Kala ti mbwuru ka bwi mu mbiili o, nde li mbwuru wu mukughu, wu aakaleene otumu nyuru a nde yohono.
Kala liikatwulu esyeŋe munsa miŋma mi basyevale mpaala bo basa bu lidzyi bihi, obo si bihi liikatumu nyuru a bo yohono.
Limono mabwara ma manene: kanswe bu mali manene, bifulu bibi mpini biikatsiini mo, lo mbwuru wu aakabiri mo, aakabiri mo oko ku aadzyi nde ogye mu nkaba yi aakabiri bwara.
Bumõ si nzalisogho yili enama kii esala mu nyuru a mbwuru, lo yo yili a masyighi mu mandagha ma manene. Limono ati bunu-a-bo mana liŋe li mbaa likughu otsughu musuru wu munene!

Ankoho nzalisogho si yili mbaa, yo yili nsie yi bubi. Nzalisogho yili enama e nyuru a bihi, yo yiikasa nyuru yohono mubviini, ya yiikatsughu elaama kyehene, buulu yo yomo yiikadzighi mu mile mimi mungele-a-mbaa.
Mawa mwohono mama banyama baba musuru, baŋmini, banyama ba baakagye mu etulu ya banyama baba mu madza bakughu osuo bo bintamana, ya mbwuru ásuo bo bintamana.
Lo nzalisogho, mbwuru si mumõ ka kughu osuo yo bintamana o! Yo yili ewa kiili ka bakughu odzarala o, ya yo yilwulu mu misuo mi miikadzwa.
Me mu nzalisogho bihi liikaseme Mfumu ya Taara, mu yo si bihi liikabiili baara ba bali mu efafaana e Nzaami mpwoho.
Mu muŋma wuunu munde ookapala liseme ya mpwoho. Bandughu ba me mu kana, ka ofaana okala obo o.
Musweswe a madza nga-mumõ kughu opaha madza ma mabwe ya mama mungba?
Bandughu ba me mu kana, muti a finge kughu oburu mburu a olibve, bwunu we musyi a bviini kughu oburu mburu a finge? Bwunu obo si musweswe a madza mama mungba ka kughu opaha madza ma mabwe o.
Bunsughu bubu nsie ya bunsughu bubu yulu
Nande ŋa kara li be li nsughu ya nga-a-mayele? Nyaã nde asuo bigyighili bi nde mu nzya-nzyara yi mbwe, mu edzuunu ya mu busunghu.
Lo kala ti be lili a sughu li mukolo, ebaa kii nkala ya bitsimi bi embagha, lo ka likakala a mutwunu mu mandagha mamo o, ya ka libyihi engaŋma mu mpya o.
Bunsughu baa bubo ka buukafa ku yulu o, bo buli babu nsie, baa embwuru ya baa mifulu mi mibi.
Mu kuulu ŋa ebini ki oli sughu li mukolo ya bitsimi bi embagha, oli a mpaatsala ya bigyighili bibi mawa-mawa bi bibi.

Lo bunsughu bubu yulu buli nsomo-a-nsomo bubu tse-tse, ŋa nseele baa edzuunu, bubu mukolo wu mubwe, bubu ogwihini, bu bulwulu mu nyiĩ ya bimburu bi bibwe, kuu ogwene a munsuolo a bidzili ya kuu ogwene a bumpibi.
Lo liburu lili bunsumu lili li bákunu kunsa edzuunu kundaa ba baakasalala edzuunu.
